domains.name: Hyperfinite 1D Transect
domains.description: The discrete real transect structured by infinitesimal step dx = 1/ω and Day ω horizon.

domains.name: Hyperfinite 2D Complex Grid
domains.description: The discrete complex plane ℝ_ω × ℝ_ω with discrete cell products and boundary edge cancellation.

domains.name: Discrete Spatial Operator
domains.description: Tridiagonal Toeplitz stencils and discrete contact Laplacians.

domains.name: Standard Observable Shadow
domains.description: Standard real numbers extracted via the standard part shadow map st(·) dropping O(dx) dust.

constructors.label: Scale Reciprocity Identity
constructors.description: Fundamental scale reciprocity: transfinite Day ω horizon and infinitesimal grid step dx are exact mutual inverses.
constructors.leanSnippet:
axiom omega : R_w
axiom dx : R_w
axiom omega_inv : omega * dx = 1

constructors.label: Discrete Difference Quotient
constructors.description: Computes the discrete forward difference quotient [f(x+dx) - f(x)] / dx on ℝ_ω.
constructors.leanSnippet:
def deriv (F : Nat → R_w) (k : Nat) : R_w :=
  (delta F k) / dx

constructors.label: Jane's 3-Point Laplacian Stencil
constructors.description: Applies Jane's symmetric discrete second-difference stencil [1, -2, 1] on ℝ_ω.
constructors.leanSnippet:
theorem laplace_symmetric_stencil (F : Nat → R_w) (k : Nat) :
  F (k + 1) - 2 * F k + F (k - 1) = delta F k - delta F (k - 1)

constructors.label: Standard Part Shadow Map
constructors.description: Extracts standard real observable by dropping infinitesimal O(dx) hyperfinite dust.
constructors.leanSnippet: axiom st : { x : R_w // is_finite x } → R_w

constructors.label: Telescoping Summation (FTC)
constructors.description: Telescoping sum of discrete differences collapsing identically to boundary difference F(n) - F(0).
constructors.leanSnippet:
theorem telescoping_ftc (F : Nat → R_w) (n : Nat) :
  hyper_sum (delta F) n = F n - F 0

constructors.label: Complex Cell Multiplication
constructors.description: Discrete cell multiplication on ℂ_ω: (u1 + i*v1)(u2 + i*v2) = (u1*u2 - v1*v2) + i*(u1*v2 + u2*v1).
constructors.leanSnippet:
def mul (z1 z2 : C_w) : C_w :=
  ⟨(z1.re * z2.re) - (z1.im * z2.im), (z1.re * z2.im) + (z2.re * z1.im)⟩

constructors.label: Complex Amplitude Norm Squared
constructors.description: Calculates probability amplitude norm squared ||ψ||² = u² + v² on ℂ_ω.
constructors.leanSnippet:
def norm_sq (z : C_w) : R_w :=
  (z.re * z.re) + (z.im * z.im)

constructors.label: Cauchy Loop Edge Cancellation
constructors.description: Contour circulation around discrete cell loop telescopes to 0 via internal edge cancellation.
constructors.leanSnippet:
axiom cauchy_edge_cancel (z1 z2 : C_w) :
  (z2 - z1) + (z1 - z2) = ⟨0, 0⟩

constructors.label: Tridiagonal Contact Laplacian
constructors.description: Assembles N-node tridiagonal Toeplitz discrete Laplacian matrix stencil [-2, 1, 0...].
constructors.leanSnippet:
theorem telescoping_ftc (F : Nat → R_w) (n : Nat) :
  hyper_sum (delta F) n = F n - F 0
